sources.note: Primary: U+00BB open, U+00AB close. DECISION: §461 lists the double middle pair first, every example in §§461–466 and §473 uses it, and §465 assigns the low-high pair „ “ to handwriting. The list is introduced with «npr.» and is not explicitly ranked. Permitted variant, not adopted: U+201C/U+201D (dictionary entry; Pravopis 8.0 draft names it as equally common in computer typesetting). The issue's lead «„…“ / „…”» was an observation, not a norm; if the low-high pair were ever pinned its close is U+201C, not U+201D. Secondary: U+203A open, U+2039 close. DECISION and CONFLICT: §461 names the single middle pair (the counterpart of the primary), §463's own example nests „…“ and ‚…‘ inside »…«, and the Pravopis 8.0 draft example uses ‘…’; the single middle pair is listed in both editions. innerSpace none for both. Q-W: primary WIDE, secondary NARROW. elisionIdioms and elisionClitics are empty: §468 (Opuščaj) gives no closed set. Confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH that »…« is the print norm of the edition in force; MEDIUM on the secondary. The PDF has no text layer and was read as page images, so code points are identified from glyph shape (MEDIUM-HIGH). Pravopis 8.0 (predlog, 2026) is a draft not in force and is cited only as a secondary check. Retrieved 2026-10-24.

sources.note: (1) beforeUnits = %, ‰, €, °C, kg, km. %, °C, kg, km are in the edition in force; ‰ and € are from the draft only (SECONDARY). DECISIONS: single-letter units (m, g, V, a) are excluded although §610 names m, because they are common words or initials (as in hr, sk, bg); $ and £ are out; bare ° is never listed. (2) afterSymbols = §: draft, SECONDARY; the edition shows only the spaced form («§ 49», §235). (3) abbreviations = t. i.: the edition gives the spaced form and the draft states the no-break intent; the other spaced abbreviations (t. l., n. m., d. d., d. o. o.) are not listed, since extending the intent to them would be a derivation. DECISION, MEDIUM. (4) afterShortWords is empty: §612 concerns word division, not one-letter prepositions; nothing is imported from cs or sk. (5) beforePunctuation and narrowBeforePunctuation are empty: §228 puts punctuation closed up. (6) beforeNumber, beforeWord are empty and initialBinding = none: only the spaced form of « dr. F. Prešeren » is shown. Decisions, not citations. The PDF has no text layer and was read as page images, so code points are identified from glyph shape (MEDIUM-HIGH).
